subject: SLA & Premium Support — tiers, response times, and pricing
messages:
From: Mike Holmes <mike.holmes@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Enterprise SLA and premium support pricing

Hi Marissa —

We're kicking off the deployment planning for our product team and need a clear breakdown of your SLA and premium support packaging. Important items for us: uptime guarantees (and credits), on-call escalation windows, response times for Sev1/Sev2, coverage hours (24x7 vs business), and how pricing scales with committed capacity (we're evaluating both hosted and private/dedicated options).

Can you send the standard tiers and a first-pass quote for an expected 50 qps steady-state (spiky to ~120 qps) across us-west + eu? Also confirm whether you offer any one-time discounts for enterprise onboarding and multi-year commitments.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Mike Holmes
Platform Engineering, Acme Corp

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Holmes <mike.holmes@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA and premium support pricing

Hi Mike —

Thanks — summarized below are our standard premium support / SLA tiers. I'm attaching Redwood_SLA_Tiers_v2.pdf with formal language and sample credits. Quick highlights:

- Bronze (standard): 99.5% uptime, business-hours support (M-F 9-5 PT), Sev1 response < 4 hours, no 24x7 escalation. Included for all hosted customers.
- Silver (premium): 99.9% uptime, extended hours (M-F 8-8 PT), Sev1 response < 2 hours, on-call escalation to L2 outside hours, monthly review. + managed surge pricing.
- Gold (enterprise): 99.95% uptime, 24x7 on-call, Sev1 response < 30 minutes, dedicated escalation path to SREs, quarterly playbook reviews, named SLA owner. Includes faster credit cadence and prioritized capacity during incidents.

Pricing model (first-pass, per-month):
- Hosted + Bronze: no additional SLA fee (usage charges apply)
- Hosted + Silver: $6,500/mo (adds 24x5 extended support and SLA guarantees)
- Hosted + Gold: $18,000/mo (24x7 coverage, named contacts, guaranteed staffing)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Gold: $40,000/mo (includes reserved GPU pools + enterprise routing + 24x7 Gold support)

Uptime credits: credits scale with downtime percentage and are different for hosted vs dedicated; details are in the attached PDF.

Discounting & packaging notes:
- We commonly offer 10% on first-year billing with a 12-month annual commitment.
- For multi-year commitments or reserved capacity (Dedicated), we can extend to 15%–25% depending on committed spend and term length.
- One-time onboarding credit can be offered to offset professional services if you sign by EOY.

To give a tighter price for your 50 qps (spikes to 120 qps) across two regions I need: expected monthly token volume (or approximate RPS across day), whether you'll require dedicated capacity for any % of traffic, and payment term preference (Net30 vs Net45/advance). If you'd like, we can book a 30-min call this week to align and I can get Rafael looped on negotiated terms.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_Tiers_v2.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Mike Holmes <mike.holmes@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA and premium support pricing

Thanks Marissa. Quick answers:
- Expected monthly token volume: ~9M tokens (mostly generation), peak RPS by region: us-west ~80 rps, eu ~40 rps during spikes.
- We expect to keep ~20% of traffic on dedicated for compliance-critical paths; rest can go hosted.
- Procurement preference: 12-month initial term, looking for Net45.

A few clarifying Qs:
1) For the Gold/Dedicated tier, does the uptime SLA include cross-region failover within the same service level, or is dedicated per-region?
2) Can you provide a one-time implementation/onboarding credit for professional services?
3) What discount bands are achievable for our profile (12-mo commit + partial dedicated + $XXk ARR estimate)?

Attached: Acme_Estimated_QPS_2026.csv (traffic breakdown).

Would like to keep this to a single negotiated SLA line item if possible.

-Mike

---

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Holmes <mike.holmes@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enterprise SLA and premium support pricing

Hi Mike / Marissa —

Thanks for the detail, Mike. A few operational clarifications and an initial commercial proposal from our side:

Operational:
- Dedicated capacity is provisioned per-region unless you request a cross-region active-active design. We can support active-active but that increases reserved capacity needs and cost.
- Gold SLA covers failover behavior and credits across the contract if we own the routing (i.e., Hosted Gold or Dedicated managed routing). Cross-region active-active requires explicit design & a higher capacity reservation.

Commercial (first-pass):
- Option A — Hosted (Silver for primary + Gold for 20% dedicated critical paths): $12,000/mo blended (est) — includes Silver SLA baseline and Gold for the dedicated slice.
- Option B — Dedicated Gold for both regions (active-passive failover): $68,000/mo reserved — includes 24x7 Gold support and higher priority on-capacity bursts.

Discounting policy we can apply for ACME profile:
- 12-month commit (Net45): standard 10% first-year discount.
- If Acme commits to Dedicated capacity for at least one region (12-mo), we can extend to 15% year-one discount.
- One-time onboarding credit: up to $12,000 to offset PS work if agreement signed by 2025-12-31.

I can make an internal exception request for a larger commercial concession (up to 20% on year-one) if procurement signs to a 24-month commit and pays 50% upfront. If you'd like that route, I can escalate to VP.

Operational note on credits: credits are pro-rated monthly and tiered by downtime windows; we don't do SLA termination for short downtimes, only credit.

If you approve, I can draft a draft commercial term sheet and a sample SOW for onboarding.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com

---

Rafael: please include this exception in the term sheet and route through legal for a standard concession approval. Marissa: proceed to send the commercial term sheet + DocuSign link.
